how_to_apply: Open the official notification and access the respective online Google form link based on the post.

The appointment will be purely on a temporary basis for a period of maximum 12 months or till completion of project whichever is earlier. In case the candidate wishes to resign from the post, he/she should furnish a notice of one month period. Once the project duration is completed the tenure is automatically over for all candidates selected for this project. If the appointee is not able to fulfil the prescribed norms for output in terms of quality and quantity of work, his/her services will be terminated without giving any notice. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

The tentative date of interview is 26/10/2026 (Monday) starting at 10:30 AM (reporting time 9:00 AM) at the Department of Community Medicine, 4th floor, Medical College building, AIIMS, Nagpur.

content_sections.text: Open the official notification and access the respective online Google form link based on the post. Fill out the application form online through the Google form link for Project Technical Support I (Medical Social Worker) or Project Technical Support I (Laboratory Technician). Prepare the hard copy of the duly filled application form (as per the prescribed Proforma) along with passport size photo for the interview. Gather all required documents including birth certificate/10th marks sheet, academic certificates, experience certificates, and council registration if applicable. Bring the hard copy of the application form, original certificates, and a photocopy of all relevant certificates on the day of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth certificate/ 10th marks sheet Certificates supporting academic qualifications and academic achievements Registration in relevant councils if applicable Work experience certificates Application form with passport size photo

No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 is an advertisement for hiring Project Technical Support - I (Medical Social Worker and Laboratory Technician) positions under an ICMR funded research project in the Department of Community Medicine.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, with 2 posts for Project Technical Support - I (Medical Social Worker) and 1 post for Project Technical Support - I (Laboratory Technician).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 17 October 2026, Saturday by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support - I (MSW/Nurse)?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10th + Bachelors in Social Work/ Bachelors in Psychology/ Nursing or equivalent + two years of experience, or a three-year graduate degree in relevant subject + one year experience, or a 3-year graduate degree in social work/sociology + 3 years experience, or PG in social work/sociology with minimum one year research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years on the date of interview, with age relaxation according to GOI rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Nagpur Project Posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application online through the respective Google form links provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection is through personal interview, and a preliminary written test may be conducted prior to the interview if there are more than ten eligible candidates for a post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The proposed monthly consolidated salary is Rs 21,600/- (Rs 18,000 + 20% HRA).

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The tentative date of interview is 26 October 2026 (Monday), with reporting time at 9:00 AM at AIIMS Nagpur.
